verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent can be steered with natural-language runbooks for specific scenarios, and admins control which issues it touches via assignment and trigger-based automations. Simulation testing and an issue log offer some way to check its behavior, but no documentation describes handoff or escalation rules. missing for 10: explicit handoff/escalation configuration, documented conditions for topic, sentiment, customer tier and explicit human-request handoff, evidence that the agent reliably obeys handoff rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
